alerts.title: NH44 Jammu-Srinagar Highway remains shut after fresh landslide at Dewal, Udhampur
alerts.summary: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (NH44) — the only all-weather road link connecting the Kashmir Valley with the rest of India — remains closed after a landslide triggered by heavy rain blocked the carriageway at Dewal in Udhampur district. Restoration crews are working under active rockfall risk near the Dawal Bridge/Samroli area; authorities have not yet declared the stretch safe to reopen.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM hit: Kashmir-bound linehaul via NH44 has no alternate road route — expect multi-day TAT breaches for Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag hubs. Hold non-serviceable (NS) flags for Valley pincodes and pre-build buffer stock at the Jammu hub until NHAI confirms full reopening.

alerts.title: Himachal: cloudburst devastates Boh Valley villages in Kangra, 25 homes destroyed
alerts.summary: A cloudburst around 11am struck Speda village under Boh Panchayat (Shahpur constituency, Kangra district), sending flash floods and landslides through Speda, Gharghoon, Lam and Bhagar villages. 18 houses were damaged including 6 completely washed away; footpaths and traditional irrigation channels (kuhls) were destroyed. ~25 families were shifted to a relief camp at Boh's government school; three large boulders remain precariously perched above the village.
alerts.impact: Hill-route capacity risk — very localized: Boh Valley (Speda/Gharghoon/Lam/Bhagar) pincodes under Shahpur/Kangra face direct route damage. Treat as a temporary NS zone rather than penalizing 3P non-adherence; CM Sukhu has announced a relief package (₹7.5 lakh/destroyed home) so expect weeks of local reconstruction traffic too.

alerts.title: Gujarat floods: red alert in 15 districts, 16,500+ evacuated, Surat gets 24 inches of rain
alerts.summary: IMD issued a red alert across 15 Gujarat districts including Ahmedabad and Vadodara; Surat recorded roughly 24 inches of rain. Over 16,500 people were evacuated statewide — 4,000+ from Surat's rural areas, 114 rescued from Bilimora (Navsari), 27 from Chhota Udaipur, and 311 students moved from a flooded school campus in Dang. Four deaths were reported from electrocution and drowning. Dam releases from Machhu-2, Nayka and Bhogavo-2 have triggered high alerts for downstream villages.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — West zone: Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Navsari, Chhota Udepur and Dang hubs face waterlogged last-mile routes and rural inaccessibility. Flag NS status for downstream dam-release villages and pre-position buffer stock at the Ahmedabad hub until the red alert lifts.

alerts.title: Kerala: 7 dead incl. 3 children as rain floods Kottayam's Pala & Erattupetta towns
alerts.summary: A day of torrential rain on August 1 killed seven people including three children. Kottayam district saw widespread damage with the towns of Pala and Erattupetta inundated. Pathanamthitta's Sabarimala/Ranni belt saw rapidly rising water levels. Nine districts were under red alert on Aug 1; by Aug 3 an orange alert covers 10-12 districts (Pathanamthitta, Ernakulam, Kottayam, Thrissur, Palakkad, Alappuzha, Idukki, Malappuram, Wayanad, Kozhikode, Kannur, Kasaragod) with more heavy rain expected through Aug 8.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — South zone, very localized: Pala and Erattupetta (Kottayam) and Ranni (Pathanamthitta) are specifically named flood towns — hold NS flags for these exact pincodes rather than the whole district. Route via Kochi/Kozhikode hubs with extended TAT buffers through Aug 8.

alerts.title: Assam: Brahmaputra erosion hits Tezpur, Barpeta & Dibrugarh villages simultaneously
alerts.summary: Brahmaputra riverbank erosion is actively eating into land at multiple, unrelated points: Tezpur's historic Tal Kalibari locality (Sonitpur district) lost large stretches of riverbank, prompting a site visit by the local MLA and Deputy Commissioner; Doulashal village near Roumari Pathar (Barpeta district) has faced a month of severe erosion approaching a Water Resources Department embankment; and Mohanaghat in Tingkhong (Dibrugarh district) is seeing fresh erosion triggering panic among residents.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Northeast, village-specific: Tal Kalibari (Sonitpur), Doulashal/Roumari Pathar (Barpeta) and Mohanaghat/Tingkhong (Dibrugarh) pincodes risk sudden road/access loss as riverbanks give way. Flag these named villages for NS status proactively rather than waiting for a full washout; keep Guwahati hub contingency routing on standby.

alerts.title: Bay of Bengal low pressure triggers cyclone warning at 9 Tamil Nadu/Puducherry ports
alerts.summary: A low-pressure system over the west-central/northwest Bay of Bengal near the north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coast has triggered Cyclone Warning Signal No. 1 at nine ports: Nagapattinam, Chennai, Cuddalore, Puducherry, Karaikal, Ennore, Pamban, Kattupalli and Thoothukudi. Heavy rain is likely along the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha coast, with intermittent showers over northeastern Tamil Nadu.
alerts.impact: Watch closely, pre-plan port-linked linehaul: FM pickups tied to Chennai/Cuddalore/Karaikal/Thoothukudi ports may see gusty-wind and rain disruption. No stoppage yet — monitor IMD's next 48-hour track update before flagging NS for coastal TN/Puducherry/Odisha pincodes.

alerts.title: South India truckers' indefinite strike over VLTD mandate begins August 1
alerts.summary: Truck owners' associations across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Puducherry went ahead with a threatened indefinite strike from August 1, opposing mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs) and panic buttons, plus rising toll and compliance costs. Reports on ground-level participation and duration are still developing.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P, monitor hour-by-hour: FM linehaul out of Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs is at risk. Keep 5-7 days of buffer inventory pre-positioned, line up alternate LM partners, and prepare SLA-relaxation comms for southern pincodes until the strike is confirmed resolved.

alerts.title: Karnataka: repeated landslides in Chikkamagaluru's coffee belt, Kodagu on alert
alerts.summary: Heavy monsoon rain triggered a landslide near the Mullaiyanagiri foothills in Chikkamagaluru and repeated slides on the Charmadi Ghat stretch. A massive retaining wall developed major cracks in Sringeri, raising fresh landslide fears, while a slide at Meluholadagadde near Mallandur left a 200-foot-deep gorge. Kodagu (Coorg) also faces landslide threats as rain continues.
alerts.impact: Hill-route capacity risk — very localized: Charmadi Ghat and the Sringeri-Kalasa coffee belt (Chikkamagaluru) plus Kodagu hill routes are prone to repeat closures. Pre-clear buffer stock at Mangaluru/Hassan hubs and hold alternate courier partners on standby for coffee-belt pincodes.

alerts.title: Maharashtra: ground fissures spotted outside homes in Pasarwadi hamlet, Pune ghats
alerts.summary: Pasarwadi, a hamlet of 35 Mahadev Koli tribal families in Pune's Ambegaon taluka (Western Ghats), is showing a two-foot-deep ground fissure outside homes — an early warning sign of slope instability. Pune district's 2025-26 disaster plan lists only 23 'landslide prone' villages even though Maharashtra's own 2024 Landslide Management Plan flagged 908 such villages statewide, including the Konkan's Ratnagiri Kashedi ghat belt on the Mumbai-Goa Highway.
alerts.impact: Early-warning watch — West zone, single-village signal: A fissure like Pasarwadi's is exactly the kind of hyperlocal early signal that can escalate fast. Keep Pune/Ambegaon and Ratnagiri (Kashedi ghat, Mumbai-Goa Highway) on a landslide watch-list and pre-identify alternate LM routing before the next heavy spell.

alerts.title: West Bengal: IMD forecasts widespread heavy rain over Burdwan-Murshidabad belt through Aug 7
alerts.summary: IMD Kolkata forecasts widespread rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal through August 2-7, with heavy to very heavy rain (7-20cm) expected in East & West Burdwan, Murshidabad and Birbhum districts, plus thunderstorms and gusty winds (30-40 kmph) across North 24 Parganas, Nadia and North Bengal.
alerts.impact: Cost/route watch, pre-plan: Burdwan-Murshidabad-Birbhum belt and North 24 Parganas/Nadia hubs should build in transit buffers through Aug 7. No confirmed stoppage yet — monitor for waterlogging-driven LM delays in Kolkata's outer districts.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026: Delhi route diversions live, full Delhi-Haridwar highway ban from Aug 4
alerts.summary: Delhi Traffic Police's Kanwar Yatra advisory (Jul 30 - Aug 12) is in effect: heavy vehicles are restricted/diverted on GT Road, Wazirabad Road, Vikas Marg and Loni Road, with GT Road (Apsara Border to Yamuna Bridge) fully closed Aug 9-12. Separately, all vehicle movement will be banned on the Ganga Canal road and Delhi-Haridwar Highway from August 4 to August 12.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P, pre-plan now: Linehaul on Delhi-Meerut-Haridwar (NH58), Ghaziabad, and connecting UP/Uttarakhand corridors faces a total ban Aug 4-12. Shift linehaul to alternate NH-9/NH-44 corridors or night slots outside restricted windows for NCR/UP/Uttarakhand/Haryana pincodes through Aug 12.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel steady at multi-city highs; commercial LPG cut ~₹200 from Aug 1
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged since the May 25 OMC hike — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20 per litre (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.18/₹99.82. Separately, commercial (19kg) LPG cylinder rates were cut by roughly ₹200 effective August 1, while 14.2kg domestic cylinder rates stayed flat.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: No immediate LM/FM disruption. Retail fuel staying flat is a mild positive for 3P per-km rate stability, but track weekly for the next OMC pricing cycle and any fresh crude volatility feeding into Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees surcharge asks.
